correctness.rationale: Exact inclusion–exclusion gives D_{q,p}=h_q(t)-h_q(pt) almost everywhere. Coupling on p grid intervals and the at-most-one bound on h_q density give Kolmogorov error <=2(q-1)/p. Limiting moments follow from elementary integrals. On n=3p, exact cell integration produces a fifth-power numerator. Decomposing indices j=kp+3a+u proves its dependence on each p congruence class is a polynomial in m=(p-kappa)/3 of degree <=6. All seven determining interpolation nodes in each class are exactly certified by the included executable using integer arithmetic; independent direct rational integrals agree for 123 primes. All denominators are nonzero in p>=5; no finite sampling is substituted for a general proof.

value.rationale: The motivating 2026 work explicitly reduces an unresolved fourth Delange integral to squarefree composite moduli. The first odd two-prime family 3p is a natural exact evaluation target; its congruence-class split solves an explicit case of that stated problem. The supplementary full limiting law with quantitative Kolmogorov rate explains and generalizes the limiting moment across each fixed second-prime factor. The work is not merely a numerical table or already-known second-moment formula.
